reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2418 b, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ طَلْحَةَ وَالزُّبَيْرِ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ تَعْنِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَالزُّبَيْرَ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us, Abu Usamah narrated to us, Hisham narrated to us, with this chain of narration, and he added: meaning Abu Bakr and al-Zubayr.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2418 c, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ طَلْحَةَ وَالزُّبَيْرِ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنِ الْبَهِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ قَالَتْ لِي عَائِشَةُ كَانَ أَبَوَاكَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Kurayb Muhammad ibn al-'Ala' narrated to us, Waki' narrated to us, Isma'il narrated to us, from al-Bahi, from 'Urwah, who said: 'A'ishah said to me: "Your two fathers were among those who responded to Allah and the Messenger after injury had afflicted them."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2419 a, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ رضى الله تعالى عنه ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَمِينًا وَإِنَّ أَمِينَنَا أَيَّتُهَا الأُمَّةُ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Isma'il Ibn 'Ulayyah narrated to us, from Khalid; (H) and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, Isma'il Ibn 'Ulayyah narrated to us, Khalid informed us, from Abu Qilabah, he said: Anas said: The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said: "Indeed, every nation has a trustworthy guardian, and indeed our trustworthy guardian, O this nation, is Abu 'Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2419 b, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ رضى الله تعالى عنه ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَلَمَةَ - عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْيَمَنِ، قَدِمُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا ابْعَثْ مَعَنَا رَجُلاً يُعَلِّمْنَا السُّنَّةَ وَالإِسْلاَمَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا أَمِينُ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Amr al-Naqid narrated to me, 'Affan narrated to us, Hammad—and he is Ibn Salamah—narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas, that the people of Yemen came to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) and said: "Send with us a man to teach us the Sunnah and Islam." He said: So he took the hand of Abu 'Ubaydah and said: "This is the trustworthy man of this nation."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2420 a, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ رضى الله تعالى عنه ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ صِلَةَ بْنِ زُفَرَ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَهْلُ نَجْرَانَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ابْعَثْ إِلَيْنَا رَجُلاً أَمِينًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لأَبْعَثَنَّ إِلَيْكُمْ رَجُلاً أَمِينًا حَقَّ أَمِينٍ حَقَّ أَمِينٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاسْتَشْرَفَ لَهَا النَّاسُ - قَالَ - فَبَعَثَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar both narrated to us—and the wording is Ibn al-Muthanna's—they said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, he said: I heard Abu Ishaq narrating from Silah ibn Zufar, from Hudhayfah, who said: The people of Najran came to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) and said: "O Messenger of Allah, send to us a trustworthy man." He said: "I will certainly send to you a trustworthy man, truly trustworthy, truly trustworthy." He said: So the people craned their necks for it. He said: And he sent Abu 'Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2420 b, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ رضى الله تعالى عنه ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْحَفَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, Abu Dawud al-Hafari informed us, Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, with this chain of narration, similarly.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2421 a, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِحَسَنٍ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ فَأَحِبَّهُ وَأَحْبِبْ مَنْ يُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ahmad ibn Hanbal narrated to me, Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah narrated to us, 'Ubaydullah ibn Abi Yazid narrated to me, from Nafi' ibn Jubayr, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (pbuh), that he said to Hasan: "O Allah, indeed I love him, so love him, and love whoever loves him."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2421 b, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ، بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَائِفَةٍ مِنَ النَّهَارِ لاَ يُكَلِّمُنِي وَلاَ أُكَلِّمُهُ حَتَّى جَاءَ سُوقَ بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ حَتَّى أَتَى خِبَاءَ فَاطِمَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَثَمَّ لُكَعُ أَثَمَّ لُكَعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي حَسَنًا فَظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا تَحْبِسُهُ أُمُّهُ لأَنْ تُغَسِّلَهُ وَتُلْبِسَهُ سِخَابًا فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ أَنْ جَاءَ يَسْعَى حَتَّى اعْتَنَقَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ فَأَحِبَّهُ وَأَحْبِبْ مَنْ يُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated to us, Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ubaydullah ibn Abi Yazid, from Nafi' ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: I went out with the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) during a portion of the daytime, he not speaking to me and I not speaking to him, until he reached the marketplace of Banu Qaynuqa'. Then he returned until he reached the tent of Fatimah and said: "Is the little one there? Is the little one there?"—meaning Hasan. We thought that his mother was only detaining him to bathe him and put a necklace of beads on him. It was not long before he came running until each of them embraced his companion, and the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said: "O Allah, indeed I love him, so love him, and love whoever loves him."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2422 a, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ - حَدَّثَنَا الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ عَلَى عَاتِقِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ فَأَحِبَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh narrated to us, my father narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, from 'Adi—and he is Ibn Thabit—al-Bara' ibn 'Azib narrated to us, who said: I saw al-Hasan ibn 'Ali upon the shoulder of the Prophet (pbuh) while he was saying: "O Allah, indeed I love him, so love him."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2422 b, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالَ ابْنُ نَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ - عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاضِعًا الْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ فَأَحِبَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar and Abu Bakr ibn Nafi' narrated to us—Ibn Nafi' said: Ghundar narrated to us—Shu'bah narrated to us, from 'Adi—and he is Ibn Thabit—from al-Bara', who said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) having placed al-Hasan ibn 'Ali upon his shoulder while saying: "O Allah, indeed I love him, so love him."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2423, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الرُّومِيِّ الْيَمَامِيُّ، وَعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمَّارٍ - حَدَّثَنَا إِيَاسٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَقَدْ قُدْتُ بِنَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ بَغْلَتَهُ الشَّهْبَاءَ حَتَّى أَدْخَلْتُهُمْ حُجْرَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذَا قُدَّامَهُ وَهَذَا خَلْفَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn al-Rumi al-Yamami and 'Abbas ibn 'Abd al-'Azim al-'Anbari both narrated to me—they said: al-Nadr ibn Muhammad narrated to us, 'Ikrimah—and he is Ibn 'Ammar—narrated to us, Iyas narrated to us, from his father, who said: I led the grey mule of the Prophet of Allah (pbuh) carrying the Prophet of Allah (pbuh), al-Hasan, and al-Husayn until I brought them into the apartment of the Prophet (pbuh)—one of them before him and the other behind him.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2424, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَدَاةً وَعَلَيْهِ مِرْطٌ مُرَحَّلٌ مِنْ شَعْرٍ أَسْوَدَ فَجَاءَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ فَأَدْخَلَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَ الْحُسَيْنُ فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ فَأَدْخَلَهَا ثُمَّ جَاءَ عَلِيٌّ فَأَدْخَلَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏[quran sura="33" aya_start="22" aya_end="22"]{‏ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا‏}‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us—and the wording is Abu Bakr's—they said: Muhammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, from Zakariyya', from Mus'ab ibn Shaybah, from Safiyyah bint Shaybah, who said: 'A'ishah said: The Prophet (pbuh) went out one morning wearing an embroidered cloak made of black hair. Then al-Hasan ibn 'Ali came, and he took him under it; then al-Husayn came and entered with him; then Fatimah came and he took her under it; then 'Ali came and he took him under it. Then he recited: "Allah only intends to remove from you all impurity, O people of the household, and to purify you completely."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2425 a, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ وَأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيُّ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ مَا كُنَّا نَدْعُو زَيْدَ بْنَ حَارِثَةَ إِلاَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى نَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ ‏[quran sura="33" aya_start="5" aya_end="5"]{‏ ادْعُوهُمْ لآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ‏}‏ قَالَ الشَّيْخُ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْعَبَّاسِ السَّرَّاجُ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ الدُّوَيْرِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, Ya'qub ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Qari narrated to us, from Musa ibn 'Uqbah, from Salim ibn 'Abdullah, from his father, who used to say: We never used to call Zayd ibn Harithah anything except Zayd ibn Muhammad until the Quran revealed: "Call them by the names of their fathers; that is more just in the sight of Allah." Shaykh Abu Ahmad Muhammad ibn 'Isa said: Abu al-'Abbas al-Sarraj and Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Yusuf al-Duwayri both informed us, saying: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us this hadith.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2425 b, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ وَأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Ahmad ibn Sa'id al-Darimi narrated to me, Habban narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Musa ibn 'Uqbah narrated to us, Salim narrated to me, from 'Abdullah, the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2426 a, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ وَأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا - إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْثًا وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ فَطَعَنَ النَّاسُ فِي إِمْرَتِهِ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ تَطْعَنُوا فِي إِمْرَتِهِ فَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ تَطْعَنُونَ فِي إِمْرَةِ أَبِيهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لَخَلِيقًا لِلإِمْرَةِ وَإِنْ كَانَ لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ وَإِنَّ هَذَا لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya, Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr narrated to us—Yahya ibn Yahya said: informed us, and the others said: narrated to us—Isma'il—meaning Ibn Ja'far—from 'Abdullah ibn Dinar, that he heard Ibn 'Umar saying: The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) dispatched an expedition and appointed Usamah ibn Zayd as commander over them. Some people criticized his leadership, so the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) stood up and said: "If you criticize his leadership, you had already criticized the leadership of his father before. And by Allah, he was truly worthy of leadership, and he was indeed among the most beloved of people to me, and this one is surely among the most beloved of people to me after him."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2426 b, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ وَأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَمْزَةَ - عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏"‏ إِنْ تَطْعَنُوا فِي إِمَارَتِهِ - يُرِيدُ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ - فَقَدْ طَعَنْتُمْ فِي إِمَارَةِ أَبِيهِ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لَخَلِيقًا لَهَا ‏.‏ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لأَحَبَّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ ‏.‏ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا لَهَا لَخَلِيقٌ - يُرِيدُ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ - وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لأَحَبَّهُمْ إِلَىَّ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ فَأُوصِيكُمْ بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ صَالِحِيكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Kurayb Muhammad ibn al-'Ala' narrated to us, Abu Usamah narrated to us, from 'Umar—meaning Ibn Hamzah—from Salim, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said while upon the pulpit: "If you criticize his leadership"—meaning Usamah ibn Zayd—"you had already criticized the leadership of his father before him. And by Allah, he was truly worthy of it, and by Allah, he was indeed the most beloved of people to me. And by Allah, this one is truly worthy of it"—meaning Usamah ibn Zayd—"and by Allah, he is indeed among the most beloved of them to me after him; so I enjoin you to treat him well, for he is from among your righteous ones."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2427 a, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ لاِبْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ أَتَذْكُرُ إِذْ تَلَقَّيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَا وَأَنْتَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ فَحَمَلَنَا وَتَرَكَكَ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Isma'il Ibn 'Ulayyah narrated to us, from Habib ibn al-Shahid, from 'Abdullah ibn Mulaykah, that 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far said to Ibn al-Zubayr: "Do you remember when we met the Messenger of Allah (pbuh)—I, you, and Ibn 'Abbas?" He said: "Yes, and he carried us and left you."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2427 b, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ، بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَإِسْنَادِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, Abu Usamah informed us, from Habib ibn al-Shahid, with the like of the hadith of Ibn 'Ulayyah and his chain of narration.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2428 a, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ الْعِجْلِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ تُلُقِّيَ بِصِبْيَانِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ - قَالَ - وَإِنَّهُ قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فَسُبِقَ بِي إِلَيْهِ فَحَمَلَنِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ جِيءَ بِأَحَدِ ابْنَىْ فَاطِمَةَ فَأَرْدَفَهُ خَلْفَهُ - قَالَ - فَأُدْخِلْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ثَلاَثَةً عَلَى دَابَّةٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us—and the wording is Yahya's—Abu Bakr said: narrated to us, and Yahya said: Abu Mu'awiyah informed us, from 'Asim al-Ahwal, from Muwarriq al-'Ijli, from 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far, who said: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) returned from a journey, the children of his household would be brought out to meet him. He said: And he returned from a journey and I was rushed ahead to him, so he carried me in front of him. Then one of the two sons of Fatimah was brought, and he seated him behind him. He said: So we entered Medina, three upon a single mount.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2428 b, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُوَرِّقٌ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ تُلُقِّيَ بِنَا - قَالَ - فَتُلُقِّيَ بِي وَبِالْحَسَنِ أَوْ بِالْحُسَيْنِ - قَالَ - فَحَمَلَ أَحَدَنَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَالآخَرَ خَلْفَهُ حَتَّى دَخَلْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, 'Abd al-Rahim ibn Sulayman narrated to us, from 'Asim, Muwarriq narrated to me, 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far narrated to me, who said: Whenever the Prophet (pbuh) returned from a journey, we would be brought out to meet him. He said: So I was brought out to meet him along with al-Hasan or al-Husayn. He said: So he carried one of us in front of him and the other behind him until we entered Medina.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2429, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ رضى الله عنهما ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، مَوْلَى الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَرْدَفَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ خَلْفَهُ فَأَسَرَّ إِلَىَّ حَدِيثًا لاَ أُحَدِّثُ بِهِ أَحَدًا مِنَ النَّاسِ ‏.‏
en_text: Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated to us, Mahdi ibn Maymun narrated to us, Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'qub narrated to us, from al-Hasan ibn Sa'd, freed slave of al-Hasan ibn 'Ali, from 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far, who said: One day the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) seated me behind him on his mount, and whispered a secret to me that I will never tell to anyone among mankind.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2430, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ خَدِيجَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضى الله تعالى عنها ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَوَكِيعٌ وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، وَاللَّفْظُ، حَدِيثُ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا، بِالْكُوفَةِ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ خَيْرُ نِسَائِهَا مَرْيَمُ بِنْتُ عِمْرَانَ وَخَيْرُ نِسَائِهَا خَدِيجَةُ بِنْتُ خُوَيْلِدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَأَشَارَ وَكِيعٌ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, 'Abdullah ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah narrated to us; (H) and Abu Kurayb narrated to us, Abu Usamah, Ibn Numayr, Waki', and Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us; (H) and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, 'Abdah ibn Sulayman informed us—all of them from Hisham ibn 'Urwah, and the wording is that of the hadith of Abu Usamah; (H) and Abu Kurayb narrated to us, Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, who said: I heard 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far saying: I heard 'Ali in Kufa saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) saying: "The best of its women is Maryam bint 'Imran, and the best of its women is Khadijah bint Khuwaylid." Abu Kurayb said: And Waki' pointed to the heaven and the earth.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2431, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ خَدِيجَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضى الله تعالى عنها ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَمَلَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ كَثِيرٌ وَلَمْ يَكْمُلْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ غَيْرُ مَرْيَمَ بِنْتِ عِمْرَانَ وَآسِيَةَ امْرَأَةِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَإِنَّ فَضْلَ عَائِشَةَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ كَفَضْلِ الثَّرِيدِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الطَّعَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb both narrated to us—they said: Waki' narrated to us; (H) and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar both narrated to us—they said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us—all of them from Shu'bah; (H) and 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh al-'Anbari narrated to us—and the wording is his—my father narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, from 'Amr ibn Murrah, from Murrah, from Abu Musa, who said: The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said: "Many among men attained perfection, but none among women attained perfection except Maryam bint 'Imran and Asiyah the wife of Pharaoh. And indeed, the superiority of 'A'ishah over other women is like the superiority of tharid over all other food."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2432, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ خَدِيجَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضى الله تعالى عنها ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَتَى جِبْرِيلُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذِهِ خَدِيجَةُ قَدْ أَتَتْكَ مَعَهَا إِنَاءٌ فِيهِ إِدَامٌ أَوْ طَعَامٌ أَوْ شَرَابٌ فَإِذَا هِيَ أَتَتْكَ فَاقْرَأْ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمَ مِنْ رَبِّهَا عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَمِنِّي وَبَشِّرْهَا بِبَيْتٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مِنْ قَصَبٍ لاَ صَخَبَ فِيهِ وَلاَ نَصَبَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ سَمِعْتُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ فِي الْحَدِيثِ وَمِنِّي ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Abu Kurayb, and Ibn Numayr narrated to us—they said: Ibn Fudayl narrated to us, from 'Umarah, from Abu Zur'ah, who said: I heard Abu Hurayrah saying: Gabriel came to the Prophet (pbuh) and said: "O Messenger of Allah, here is Khadijah coming to you with a vessel containing condiment, or food, or drink. So when she comes to you, convey salam to her from her Lord, Mighty and Majestic, and from me, and give her the glad tidings of a palace in Paradise made of reeds, wherein there is neither clamor nor toil." Abu Bakr said in his narration from Abu Hurayrah: and he did not say "I heard"; nor did he say in the hadith "and from me."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2433 a, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ خَدِيجَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضى الله تعالى عنها ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى أَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَشَّرَ خَدِيجَةَ بِبَيْتٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ قَالَ نَعَمْ بَشَّرَهَا بِبَيْتٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مِنْ قَصَبٍ لاَ صَخَبَ فِيهِ وَلاَ نَصَبَ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us, my father and Muhammad ibn Bishr al-'Abdi narrated to us, from Isma'il, who said: I said to 'Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa, "Did the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) give glad tidings to Khadijah of a palace in Paradise?" He said: "Yes, he gave her glad tidings of a palace in Paradise made of reeds, wherein there is neither clamor nor toil."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2433 b, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ خَدِيجَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضى الله تعالى عنها ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَجَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, Abu Mu'awiyah informed us; (H) and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Waki' narrated to us; (H) and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, al-Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman and Jarir informed us; (H) and Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated to us, Sufyan narrated to us—all of them from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, from Ibn Abi Awfa, from the Prophet (pbuh), the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2434, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ خَدِيجَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضى الله تعالى عنها ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ بَشَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَدِيجَةَ بِنْتَ خُوَيْلِدٍ بِبَيْتٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏.‏
en_text: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, 'Abdah narrated to us, from Hisham ibn 'Urwah, from his father, from 'A'ishah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) gave glad tidings to Khadijah bint Khuwaylid of a house in Paradise.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2435 a, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ خَدِيجَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضى الله تعالى عنها ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا غِرْتُ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ مَا غِرْتُ عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ وَلَقَدْ هَلَكَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَنِي بِثَلاَثِ سِنِينَ لِمَا كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُهُ يَذْكُرُهَا وَلَقَدْ أَمَرَهُ رَبُّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَنْ يُبَشِّرَهَا بِبَيْتٍ مِنْ قَصَبٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَإِنْ كَانَ لَيَذْبَحُ الشَّاةَ ثُمَّ يُهْدِيهَا إِلَى خَلاَئِلِهَا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Kurayb Muhammad ibn al-'Ala' narrated to us, Abu Usamah narrated to us, Hisham narrated to us, from his father, from 'A'ishah, who said: I never felt jealous toward any woman as I felt jealous toward Khadijah—and she had passed away three years before he married me—because of what I used to hear him mentioning her. And her Lord, Mighty and Majestic, had commanded him to give her the glad tidings of a palace made of reeds in Paradise; and whenever he slaughtered a sheep, he would send gifts of it to her intimate friends.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2435 b, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ خَدِيجَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضى الله تعالى عنها ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا غِرْتُ عَلَى نِسَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ وَإِنِّي لَمْ أُدْرِكْهَا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا ذَبَحَ الشَّاةَ فَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَرْسِلُوا بِهَا إِلَى أَصْدِقَاءِ خَدِيجَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَأَغْضَبْتُهُ يَوْمًا فَقُلْتُ خَدِيجَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي قَدْ رُزِقْتُ حُبَّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Sahl ibn 'Uthman narrated to us, Hafs ibn Ghiyath narrated to us, from Hisham ibn 'Urwah, from his father, from 'A'ishah, who said: I never felt jealous of any of the wives of the Prophet (pbuh) except Khadijah, though I did not live during her time. She said: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) slaughtered a sheep, he would say: "Send portions of it to the friends of Khadijah." She said: One day I angered him and said: "Khadijah?!" Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said: "Indeed, I was nourished with her love."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2435 c, book 44, باب فَضَائِلِ خَدِيجَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضى الله تعالى عنها ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ إِلَى قِصَّةِ الشَّاةِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الزِّيَادَةَ بَعْدَهَا ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Abu Kurayb both narrated to us from Abu Mu'awiyah, Hisham narrated to us, with this chain of narration, similar to the hadith of Abu Usamah up to the story of the sheep, and he did not mention the addition after it.
